name: Gestao Hospital
description: Gestao Hospital centralizes the management of hospitals, patients, beds, products, and blood-bank resources. Administrators and managers maintain hospital information. Patients search for hospitals and nearby care. Healthcare staff register patients, consult medical histories, and manage appointments, check-in information, and treatment notes. Authorized staff manage products, quantities, requests, and blood samples.
rawDescription:
Gestao Hospital is a hospital management system that supports the administration of hospitals, patients, beds, products, and blood bank resources. The system allows administrators and hospital managers to register, update, delete, and monitor hospitals, while healthcare staff can manage operational information related to patients, appointments, products, and medical resources.

Patients can use the system to search for hospitals, obtain information about specific hospitals, and receive recommendations about the nearest hospital. Hospital staff can register patients, consult patient information and medical history, manage check-in related information, and maintain notes about treatments.

The system also supports hospital logistics by allowing authorized staff to manage products, quantities, requests, and blood samples. Its overall goal is to centralize hospital administration and improve the coordination of clinical and logistical activities.
highLevelGoals: Provide a unified platform to manage hospitals, patients, beds, products, and blood-bank resources across multiple facilities.
Enable hospital managers to efficiently allocate beds, staff, and supplies to improve operational performance.
Allow patients to search for nearby hospitals and schedule care services based on availability and proximity.
Enable healthcare staff to register patients, consult medical histories, manage appointments, check-ins, and treatment notes seamlessly.
Allow authorized staff to manage product inventory, request fulfillment, and blood sample tracking to ensure supply chain integrity.
lowLevelGoals: The Administrator creates hospital records with details such as name, address, contact info, and bed capacity.
The Administrator or Hospital Manager updates real-time bed occupancy status for each hospital.
The Healthcare Staff registers new patients and stores their personal and medical information in the system.
The Healthcare Staff schedules appointments for patients based on doctor availability and patient preference.
The Healthcare Staff updates patient medical records with new diagnoses, treatments, and medications.
The Healthcare Staff creates, edits, and archives treatment notes for each patient during consultations.
The Healthcare Staff records patient check-in status, including time, location, and any preliminary observations.
The Hospital Manager assigns staff and beds to specific departments based on operational needs and patient load.
The Hospital Manager generates reports on bed occupancy, staff hours, and supply usage to optimize operations.
The Patient searches for hospitals within a specified geographic radius using location-based filters.
The Patient selects and confirms a care service appointment based on real-time availability of providers and facilities.
The Authorized Staff tracks blood type availability, expiration dates, and issues alerts for low stock.
The Authorized Staff submits and tracks requests for medical supplies or equipment from inventory.

baselineCritiques.actors: The actors defined are appropriate for the system's description. However, "Hospital Manager" and "Authorized Staff" could be more specific to better reflect their roles in a hospital setting (e.g., "Hospital Operations Manager" or "Pharmacy/Inventory Staff"). Additionally, there is no distinction between different types of healthcare staff (e.g., doctors, nurses), which may be relevant for a detailed system analysis.
baselineCritiques.highLevelGoals: The high-level goals are well-defined and align with the software description. All goals are functional and address the core functionalities of Gestao Hospital, including centralized management, resource allocation, patient care access, clinical workflows, and inventory management. No contradictions or omissions were found.
baselineCritiques.lowLevelGoals: The low-level goals are well-aligned with the high-level goals and actors. All functional aspects of the system are covered, including hospital management, resource allocation, patient care workflows, and inventory/blood-bank operations. No contradictions or omissions were detected.
